items.t: Central "spider" fuel injector trouble
items.job: Replace central (spider) fuel injector assembly
items.note: The updated injector unit is the usual fix. Fix fuel leaks right away because of fire risk.

items.t: Intake manifold gasket leaks coolant
items.job: Replace lower intake manifold gaskets and coolant
items.note: Cost rises a lot if coolant in the oil damaged the engine bearings.

items.t: Front rotor and hub can crack (recall)
items.job: Replace front brake rotor and hub assembly
items.note: Price is per side. Free under GM's recall if not done. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Lower steering shaft bolt may be loose (recall)
items.job: Inspect and tighten lower steering shaft bolt
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Exhaust fumes can get into the cabin (recall)
items.job: Install missing body and wheelhouse plugs
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer. Also check the exhaust for leaks.

items.t: Gauges stick, jump, or go dead
items.job: Rebuild instrument cluster (replace gauge stepper motors)
items.note: Mail-in rebuild services are the cheapest route. Old GM special coverage has likely expired; ask a dealer.

items.t: Heated washer fluid module can overheat (recall)
items.job: Disable or replace heated washer module (recall remedy)
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: 5.3L V8 burns oil
items.job: Replace pistons and rings (GM oil consumption fix)
items.note: Shops often try a valve cover/PCV fix or AFM disable first, which costs far less. Engine replacement costs much more.

items.t: Rear axle cross pin can break (recall)
items.job: Replace rear axle differential cross pin
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer. Cost rises if the differential was damaged.

items.t: Steering shaft bolts may be loose (recall)
items.job: Inspect and tighten intermediate steering shaft bolts
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Tie rod may separate from the rack (recall)
items.job: Inspect and torque tie rod to steering rack
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer. Parts are only needed if damage is found.

items.t: Transfer case can shift into neutral (recall)
items.job: Reprogram transfer case control module
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Transmission cooler line can leak (recall)
items.job: Reseat or replace transmission cooler line fitting
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer. Clean up any spilled fluid.

items.t: Power steering assist can cut out (recall)
items.job: Power steering repair or software update (recall remedy)
items.note: Free under GM recall; check your VIN. A few SUVs needed a new steering gear, which costs much more if not covered.

items.t: A/C condenser leaks refrigerant
items.job: Replace A/C condenser and recharge system
items.note: GM special coverage may pay for this. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer first.

items.t: Reduced brake assist from vacuum pump (recall)
items.job: Replace brake vacuum pump
items.note: Often free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Unintended braking on one wheel (recall)
items.job: Update brake control software (recall remedy)
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Magnetic Ride shocks leak or knock
items.job: Replace Magnetic Ride shocks (pair)
items.note: Price is for one pair. Aftermarket units cost less than dealer parts.

items.t: Cylinder deactivation lifter failure
items.job: Replace valve lifters and camshaft
items.note: Newer SUVs may still be under powertrain warranty. Engine damage from metal debris raises the cost a lot.

items.t: Front upper control arm welds may fail (recall)
items.job: Replace front upper control arms
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer. Includes an alignment.

items.t: Missing transfer case part can lock wheels (do-not-drive recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace transfer case assembly
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer. Do not drive it until the check is done.

items.t: Fuel pump can over-pressurize and leak (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel pump module
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: 6.2L engine rod and crankshaft defect (recall)
items.job: Replace engine assembly
items.note: Covered by GM's L87 recall for affected SUVs. Check your VIN or ask the dealer before paying for anything.

items.t: 10-speed harsh shifts, limp mode or "Service Transmission"
items.job: Transmission software update and fluid service
items.note: Includes diagnosis. May be under warranty. If the transmission needs internal repair, expect much more.

items.t: Rear wheels can lock up (recall)
items.job: Reprogram transmission control software (recall remedy)
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN first. Some SUVs also get a new valve body, which costs far more if not covered.

items.t: Rear driveshaft may fail (recall)
items.job: Replace rear driveshaft assemblies
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Fuel pump control module can fail (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel pump power control module
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Power steering can cut out (recall)
items.job: Update power steering software (recall remedy)
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer. May also be done over the air.

items.t: Brake calibration problem while towing (recall)
items.job: Recalibrate brake control module (recall remedy)
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: No warning when brake fluid is lost (recall)
items.job: Update brake control software (recall remedy)
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Wrong fuel tank on some diesels (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel tank with correct part
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer.
